subject: S1I correlated-forensics diagnostic APK is CI-green and ready for physical Fold7 evidence capture
body: Prepared diagnostic-only S1I candidate on exp/stabilization-s1i-correlated-forensics-20261003. Source head 26d58927daff0258eda9550d9b4f9097a3293f73, based on validated S1H candidate 9d9861cd1be4b5488bc801fdd6cae74aa48d7311. GitHub Actions run 37161227676 passed runtime reconstruction, optimization A/B/C, wake probe, physical bridge chain, display/Hall/V4, S1-S1F, S1G, S1H, S1I source-shape checks, testFullDebugUnitTest, assembleFullDebug, packaging and artifact upload. Artifact id 11288165203, archive SHA-256 623939b98fb2e90befdc532daaa5e2e2b48821a337373468b8763f7a20c8c483. APK SHA-256 35346e69531b4bdc3b4e77ce07c01ea5869cb49c5f8e193a638748351d04fd0c. S1I adds true per-capture start/end/wall timing, backend capture duration, captured source dimensions, and one bounded correlated render/presentation snapshot for each scheduled 0/500/1200/2500 ms visual sample. Dynamic snapshot fields include device-state, display framework/power/layout, window/focus/transition state, activity/task/launcher state, wallpaper state and filtered SurfaceFlinger layers, with probe duration exported so diagnostic overhead is visible. No wake ordering, panel authority, device-state override, transition identity, render-angle math or presentation ownership behavior is changed. Next evidence gate is physical Fold7 reproduction of the first-open issue followed by export of the generated visual-forensics/debug bundle. Do not infer runtime correctness from CI alone.
